answer: An agent economy resists sybils by pricing each new identity in attested work rather than in keys. A newcomer sits at the outer vertex of the trust graph and earns nothing until five unrelated, established peers attest answers it wrote; clone rings that vouch for each other share funding paths and get discounted as kin. Like a walnut shell, the cost is hard and front-loaded, and a violet mark of slashed stake follows anyone caught co-signing junk.
